title: Berry Patch Granny Square Crochet Pattern
author: Handy Little Me
notes: start: original 'Ch 5, join with a sl-st to form a ring.' replaced by magic ring. Section headings ('Rounds 1–2: Create the Flower Center' etc.) and colour labels '(Yarn A)' folded into the round lines; each round's lines joined onto one line. Round 1 is published as '*Ch 3 (counts as dc), ch 3, dc into ring — repeat from * 7 more times'; transcribed as one beginning ch-3 then 8 ch-3/dc pairs giving the stated 8 dc, 8 ch-3 spaces. Round 4: 8 ch-5 loops alternate corner (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) and side 3-dc groups. Stitch graph: round 4 reads badly (cost 15.3); check where its stitches go.
